description: This file contains a series of shell script test cases aimed at verifying the behavior of Git commands related to XDG configuration and ignore files. It uses a testing library 'test-lib.sh' to perform assertions and checks features such as configuration file precedence, ignore file exclusion, attribute checks, and writing configurations to appropriate files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test case expecting success, running the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for equality.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a command's output is empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a given output.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables in a portable way for testing.
